top_signals.title: Gold Holds Modest Gain After Federal Reserve Keeps Rates Steady
top_signals.summary: Gold held a modest gain, after the US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged despite rising inflationary risks from the escalating war in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Malaysia’s Bond Market Outflow May Slow on Fiscal, Rate Outlooks
top_signals.summary: Global investors’ retreat from Malaysian debt may ease, supported by the country’s relatively healthy finances and efforts to ease inflationary pressures, market participants said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Cisco warns of FMC static credential flaw exploited in zero-day attacks
top_signals.summary: Cisco is warning that a high-severity Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) static credential vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-20316, was actively exploited in zero-day attacks to gain unauthorized access to vulnerable devices. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stablecoin firm Brale says new protocol can remove a major hurdle to scaling custom tokens
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
